svg.title: The Aevifex harness: how an agent works
svg.desc: An agent starts and reads AGENTS.md, the rules, then PINNED.md, the router. If the work has a plan, it goes to the office, where the plan sits with its memory, its record and its pointer, now.md; if not, the define-project skill gathers context and interviews Marc, and the planning skill writes the plan. From the pointer the agent starts working, one step of the plan at a time, in a loop: in Claude Code each command, write and web call passes a guard, run by a hook; the checks run; nothing is committed, merged or sent without Marc's yes, and the gate keeps private data out of what leaves; each turn is recorded, and hooks save the transcript around a compaction and call the note-taker, which keeps the plan's memory. Then the next step, until the plan is done. Loose ends go to the inbox as one line each, and so do Marc's own ideas to improve the system; every Monday the triage skill drains it with Marc's yes into NEXUS, his second brain, which feeds the next plan.

The guard is a hook of Claude Code: it does not run in Cowork or on reading files, and its 15 known gaps are kept as tests.
